sub: What farmers put on sale in the Jutyar app, in detail. The government sets no price: the averages here come from the farmers' own listings.
not_live: The Alwa market is not live in the farmer app yet. Listings show here as soon as farmers start using it.
empty_text: When farmers put crops on sale in the app, they show here.
close_text: The listing stops taking offers and its open offers are declined. The farmer sees the note.
del_text: The listing and its offers are removed for good. A sold listing cannot be removed.
avg_title: Average prices from the listings (IQD per kg)
avg_note: Worked out from the latest {n} listings. Asking prices of open listings; sold listings use their asking price.
boards_note: Only shown where staff have typed a price for a market and day.
